position_overview: Kirk CPA Professional Corporation Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere) Schedule: Flexible hours with at least 50% overlap between 9am5pm EST About Us: Kirk CPA Professional Corporation is a modern, fully remote accounting firm supporting entrepreneurs across Ontario and Alberta. Were detail-focused but laid-back, and we don't believe in accounting emergencies. We value flexibility, trust, and doing great work without unnecessary stress. What We Offer: Compensation: 110,000 - 150,000 p/month depending on experience Fully remote work : live and work from anywhere in the Philippines Flexible scheduling : choose your hours while meeting deadlines No micromanagement : you'll be trusted to own your work Small team impact : your ideas and expertise matter Growth opportunities : leadership, strategy, and specialized work as the company expands About the Role: We are hiring a Senior Accountant to join our growing team. You will collaborate closely with the CEO, bookkeepers, a virtual assistant, and clients to deliver accurate and friendly accounting and tax support. This role includes: Reviewing QuickBooks Online files Preparing year-end workpapers Preparing and filing corporate and personal tax returns Reviewing GST/HST returns Supporting clients and teammates with QuickBooks Online Reviewing team members work Communicating directly with clients to request documents and answer questions Key Responsibilities: Review QuickBooks Online files for accurate coding, GST/HST, A/R, A/P, and transaction completeness Troubleshoot QuickBooks Online issues for clients and team members Prepare and file T-slips Complete year-end workpapers in CaseWare Cloud Prepare and review corporate and personal tax returns using Profile Prepare year-end adjusting entries Use Karbon to manage tasks and deadlines Maintain a two-business-day response time to emails Communicate clearly and professionally with clients Qualifications Required: Corporate tax filing experience in Alberta and/or Ontario Strong experience with QuickBooks Online Experience preparing personal and corporate tax returns Experience preparing compilation engagements Experience with Profile tax software Ability to support or guide others (formal or informal leadership) Strong communication, organization, and time-management skills Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Teams) Nice to Ha
